about: Offline agent record contracts from exact source. Every time is on three made-up days, and every figure, token and hash is made up. api-source rows are answers built by Candle's pure source (the perps profile bundle, the board publish, the record composition, the round rows and the union of swaps and rounds with its cursor) from one made-up wallet's stored facts, over a stand-in spot record; each also carries the server's best closes and the web's own split of the headline figure, run as the pure function it is. The wallet's address is hashed inside that source and is in no row. api-stub rows are response stand-ins: an older bundle's rows, and refusals carrying the route's own code and words. mcp, mcp-hosted, sdk and cli rows read the same answers through the registered tool, the hosted server's route, the SDK and `candle agent record` over an intercepted fetch; a served answer is kept once, in its api row, and each of those rows names it (`relays`) with the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of what that surface gave, which the recorder checked is the same answer. docs rows are the public page's own paragraphs (its three copies agree), read as text. The database, the perps jobs, the venue and the keyed API route are not executed, and no deployed behavior is claimed.

record.description: Read one public agent’s measured record, with spot swaps and certified Hyperliquid rounds, leverage, entry and exit, size, funding, fees and return on initial margin. rowsCursor pages the combined history. perpsAsOfMs and perpsCoverageFromMs name freshness and coverage. Unknown is not zero. Measured record, not a forecast.

outcome.text: `candle agent record <profile-id> [--cursor cursor] [--json]`, SDK `getAgentRecord(profileId, { cursor })`, and MCP `candle_get_agent_record` (local and hosted) request `rows=all`: spot swaps and certified closed perp rounds, newest first. Each next `rowsCursor` pins both histories; pass it as `cursor`, and restart paging if it expires. These reads send no credential and retain the same public-agent gate.

A `kind: "perp_round"` row preserves the full `dex:COIN` name and adds `size` (largest size reached), `entryPx` (average basis at that size), `exitPx` (size-weighted reductions), `fundingUsd` (positive earned), `feesUsd`, `durationMs`, `initialMarginUsd` and `returnPct`. Initial margin is entry average × largest size / leverage; ROE is net round P&L / that margin × 100. Leverage uses the last landed Candle leverage action before open, else the highest certified observation during the round. `leverageSource` names `order` or `snapshot`; unknown leverage and return are null. Older published bundles omit the added fields. No wallet or account value is added to a round.

`perpsAsOfMs` stamps every perps figure, including the last certified time when unavailable. `perpsCoverageFromMs` names the start of stored coverage. The ALL chart's `perpsCountedFromMs` marks the first published perps day; earlier points exclude perps where certified historical daily values are unavailable. Measured record, not a forecast. Past results do not predict future results.
